propositions: _convert resolves _pandoc_timeout per unit, causing load_config to invoke git rev-parse --show-toplevel once per conversion instead of once per render pass, resulting in 886 redundant root-discovery subprocesses across 884 production conversions.

Timeout resolution is a render-pass invariant that can be moved outside the per-unit loop and threaded through optional parameters to _convert and _render_unit while preserving safe defaults for direct callers.
The fix reduces 884-unit trace from 1770 Popen calls (884 Pandoc + 886 git-root) to 887 Popen calls (884 Pandoc + 3 one-time root probes) with identical byte-for-byte Pandoc output.
All 884 real production Pandoc conversions, per-unit timeout fallback, timeout configurability, and process-group reap behavior must remain unchanged.
Held-out oracle confirms exactly one timeout resolution per render pass; defect-seeded mutation returns to three resolutions, validating the fix.
Session-scoped configuration resolution aligns with OSS consensus (Django LazySettings, Black mode passing, pytest session Config) and eliminates non-assertion-critical lookup work.
